name: Jezebel
bio: A woman at Thyatira, called "Jezebel" after the notorious Old Testament queen, called herself a prophetess and was rebuked by Christ for teaching and seducing his servants into sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols; she was given time to repent but refused, and Christ warned of severe judgment on her and those who followed her teaching (Revelation 2:20-23). She is a different figure from Jezebel, wife of King Ahab.
